entry.title: 432 Park Avenue
entry.note: Fresh OSM API snapshot on 2026-10-10 confirms exact Q233940 main outline 261499924, separate 30m podium 463386820, offset shaft 463593207 and main entrance 5995346749. All three footprint arrays equal the preserved source evidence. Native +X points 28.550deg east of north toward 57th Street, +Z points southeast toward Park Avenue. The mapped main entrance lies on native -X, agreeing with the architect 56th Street arrival and resolving the 180deg ambiguity. The published 28.5m shaft is not enlarged to the whole podium. Retained anchor and heading use a rigid pose, no scale change. Accepted map registration tolerance is 2m and 1 degree. Ground Y0 is the main entry datum; absolute elevation and street grade are supplied by the host and are unmeasured. Footprint replacement is disabled so separately mapped neighboring/site buildings remain available. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.

reviewCameraOnlyRebinding.reason: The merged branch changed model geometry since the previous approval.
